author: claude-sports-db-fix
method: DNA-style signal inversion on losing equity strategies (user directive: 'inverse/dna transform the losing, backtest for edge')
retraction_notice: v1 of this artifact claimed combined +30% inverse edge from 5 losing strategies based on n=15 slice. Monte Carlo test on true n=81 dataset invalidated that. See true_population_analysis below.

true_population_analysis.method: Scan ALL closed EQUITY picks from picks.recent_closed for the 5 strategies originally flagged as losing

monte_carlo_summary.conclusion: Inverse has no edge. Null hypothesis (random direction) not rejected.

honesty_caveats: v1 claim was based on 15-trade slice; full n=81 inverts the conclusion
Even the 2 genuine losers have samples too small (n=4, n=11) to justify real-money inverse
Statistical process lesson: bootstrap/permutation test ALL strategy claims before acting on eyeballed slices
Paper-track observation only until n>=30 per strategy and Wilson 95% CI lower bound > 50%
